Donald Trump didn't surprise anyone by [welcoming the
death](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-robert-mueller-death-celebrates) of Robert
Mueller, an American hero who exemplified all the admirable qualities he does
not possess.

But the president's fresh demonstration of depravity underscored a defining
characteristic of his presidency. I do not mean corruption, or dishonesty, or
ignorance, though Trump is thoroughly corrupt, dishonest, and ignorant.

I mean his anger. For all the wealth, fame, and power he has accumulated,
Trump is an angry man directing an angry administration.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

He was angry at Mueller, a decorated combat veteran and former FBI director,
for obvious reasons. As Justice Department special counsel, Mueller documented
the extensive interactions between Trump's Russian benefactors and his 2016
campaign, and prosecuted some of his closest aides and allies.

But Trump seethes at anyone who spotlights his failures, investigates his
crimes, or interferes with his self-aggrandizement. That includes partisan
opponents (["radical left
lunatics"](https://www.politico.com/news/2025/09/11/trump-says-we-have-to-
beat-the-hell-out-of-radical-left-lunatics-after-kirk-killing-00559170)),
Supreme Court justices (["unpatriotic and disloyal"](https://zeteo.com/p/time-
for-trump-to-go)), journalists ("fake news"), and television comedians (["late
night
morons"](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/116235861005528220)).

All expose facets of his life as a con man, so he uses his influence to menace
them legally, politically, financially, or physically.
